card.name: Closing punctuation before new text
card.fires_on: Closing punctuation such as a smiley, ".)", "..." or quote marks that ends a heading, abbreviation or short chunk, right before unrelated new text begins.

modes.label: Heading '(cont.)'
modes.description: The period or bracket closing "(cont." in a page heading, followed by the article text.

modes.label: Smiley or ellipsis
modes.description: An emoticon or ellipsis ending a casual sentence, with a new sentence or section following.

modes.label: Closing bracket after abbreviation
modes.description: A period and bracket closing a dictionary-style abbreviation or a number.

card.plain: It fires on a closing mark like ".)" or ":)" at the end of a short piece of text, just before something new starts.
